r8_findings.title: Production Paseo runtime and git.testRun never produce execution attestations; normal Controller stops at the first attested transition
r8_findings.observed: PaseoAgentRuntime.execute returns role/phase/agentId/dispatchId/verdict/summary/findings/raw but no attestation (src/agents.mjs:54). git.testRun returns {pass,receipts} without attestation (src/git.mjs:134). Store requires attestation for ROLE_TERMINAL, REVIEW_SEAT_RECORDED and TEST_RECEIPTS (src/store.mjs:558-559). A production-like runtime result is rejected; production git.testRun is rejected with 'independently attested Tester commands required'. The 77-test suite uses a test-only witness and a mock testRun that attaches signatures, so CI green does not cover the production path.
r8_findings.impact: Even with a trusted external signing key deployed, the current Controller/Paseo adapter has no integration point to attach the signed execution attestation. Every normal task will fail closed at Planner/Worker/Tester, not just at real P0.
r8_findings.minimal_fix: Add an explicit external-attestor adapter outside the Agent, have PaseoAgentRuntime obtain a signed receipt after verifying the real Paseo session, have git.testRun submit its command receipts to the same independent attestor, and add an end-to-end production-path test that does not hold the witness private key in the Controller process.

r8_findings.title: Human and execution trust domains accept the same Ed25519 public key; purpose isolation is not enforced
r8_findings.observed: A manifest with the same key ID and PEM in human and execution is accepted; verifyExecutionAttestation accepts an execution statement signed by that key. There is no disjoint-key/key-fingerprint assertion, so a human signer can also impersonate the independent execution witness.
r8_findings.impact: The intended separation between human approval and independent execution attestation is only a naming convention. A single key compromise or misconfiguration collapses both trust roots.
r8_findings.minimal_fix: Reject identical public-key fingerprints across human/execution maps and require distinct key IDs and key material; document separate custody.

r8_findings.title: Execution attestation has no lower-bound freshness and nonce is not consumed
r8_findings.observed: verifyExecutionAttestation checks only issuedAt <= now+120000; a 24h-old signed attestation was accepted. nonce is format-checked but not stored/consumed. Context binding limits reuse, but there is no freshness/replay ledger for execution receipts.
r8_findings.impact: An old valid receipt can be reused where the same task/role/phase/commit/agent/dispatch/raw still matches; no cryptographic freshness bound.
r8_findings.minimal_fix: Add a lower freshness bound and/or a consumed execution-attestation table keyed by issuer/nonce; bind dispatch-created time.

r8_findings.title: A signed reviewer seat for a different commit can be appended to history
r8_findings.observed: REVIEW_SEAT_RECORDED for a seat whose h.sha is a different commit is accepted into append-only history. It cannot satisfy A_REVIEW_PASS because #verifyReviewerPair filters by t.currentSha, but it pollutes history and consumes append-only space.
r8_findings.impact: No current-gate bypass; history pollution/DoS and misleading audit trail.
r8_findings.minimal_fix: At REVIEW_SEAT_RECORDED, require h.sha===nextTask.currentSha and h.phase===current review prefix, not merely self-consistent attestation.

r8_findings.title: Failed human approval leaves a registered approval artifact; retry fails EEXIST
r8_findings.observed: Controller.approve writes and registers approval-0-1.json (or approval-5-9.json) before store.save. A subsequent save failure (nonce replay, later assertion) leaves the artifact. Retrying with a new signed proof hits EEXIST on the same filename. First task remains unchanged; second is permanently wedged until manual cleanup.
r8_findings.impact: Operational fail-closed wedge of a Gate; manual reconciliation required; no automatic cleanup of a failed approval attempt.
r8_findings.minimal_fix: Make approval-artifact creation and state transition atomic, or support an idempotent unique approval filename plus explicit failed-attempt reconciliation; do not reuse a registered filename blindly.
